instructions: 1. Connect each mailbox you want read (your Google account connection) and write one record:mailbox row per mailbox with its address and connection handle, status connected; or pour the example rows into the list you keep (see pour).
2. Write your record:inbox-setup:dispositions row: the dispositions a thread can get and, for each pursuit, the task list and trunk task its threads are filed under (start from the example rows).

3. Say "Run workflow:handle-every-inbox-daily", or switch on its wake every-morning; it reads new mail, triages each thread, files what needs you as tasks, drafts replies in your voice and sends nothing.
4. Read the one line it says in the chat and the record:inbox-summary row of the day; open the first task it names, and say yes to the drafts you want sent.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for your mail accounts and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and list:mailboxes as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
